title: [spec-gap][R-11-026/027/030] /diag family: C /diag shape diverges; /diag/raw/* only unmounted Python classes (spec 17.5.4)
description: Spec 17.5.4: GET /diag summary {available, raw{rx, rx_events, tx, max_frame_len=255}}; GET/PUT /diag/raw/rx arming (ttl_s, remaining_s, max_ttl_s=300, include_payload); observable /diag/raw/rx/events (frame, rssi_dbm, snr_db, uptime_ms, freq_hz, crc_ok); raw RX must not divert frames from IPv6 stack. Classification: divergent + not-wired. Evidence: C GET /diag returns event array {ts,sub,code,detail} not the summary map (lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/lichen_diag.c:92-140); Python implements exact shapes (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/raw_rx.py:25-159, raw_diag.py:30-91 MAX_TTL_S=300) but build_site() never mounts them (site.py has no diag registration); no live producer calls RawRxEventsResource.publish; no raw-RX frame tap in C/Rust. Vectors exist (test/vectors/raw_diag_ttl.json, lci_raw_diag.json) and tests pass (test_raw_rx_resource.py). Suggested placement: mount raw-diag family in python build_site; reshape C /diag or split /diag/events from summary; add firmware raw-RX tap with copy-not-divert semantics; wire events producer. Related: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.40 covers server-side enforcement MUSTs.
